subject: OrbitHealth — post-call recap & invoice estimate
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Harris <jordan.harris@orbithealth.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@orbithealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: OrbitHealth — post-call recap & invoice estimate

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

Summary:
- Use case: clinical note summarization + search embeddings for provider portal (short responses, max ~256 tokens).
- Expected peak concurrency: ~60 rps for inference across the cluster; average request size ~300 input tokens / 150 output tokens.
- Monthly expected usage: 120M–320M tokens (conservative to aggressive scenarios).

Attachments I shared: orbithealth-pricing-model.xlsx (token-level cost model), token-cost-breakdown.csv (sample token distribution). I also exported a short invoice-style estimate (redwood_invoice_estimate.pdf) showing monthly cost ranges by tier.

Key questions / asks for you: 
1) Can you confirm the expected monthly token volume range (the 120M–320M above) or give a narrower band?
2) Do you have target unit economics — i.e., target $/1M tokens range for procurement to evaluate?
3) Any internal procurement cadence / approval deadlines we should be aware of?

Proposed next steps:
- You review the attached XLSX; we'll update the model to a final estimate once you confirm volumes and any preferred SLA/retention options.
- If the numbers look good, Marissa can pull together a draft order form / invoice and a DocuSign for MSA.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a short version of the unit economics after you confirm volumes.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
(415) 555-0137

Attachment: orbithealth-pricing-model.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: token-cost-breakdown.csv (CSV)
Attachment: redwood_invoice_estimate.pdf (PDF)

From: Jordan Harris <jordan.harris@orbithealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@orbithealth.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrbitHealth — post-call recap & invoice estimate

Thanks Sean — appreciate the recap and the files. Quick answers: 
- The 120M–320M band is a decent starting point. If forced to pick, procurement will probably expect an initial commit around ~150M tokens/month with a 3–6 month ramp to ~300M depending on pilot results.
- Target unit economics: we'd like to see pricing in the $300–$500 per 1M tokens range to get internal buy-in. Anything above $600/1M will be a hard sell.
- Procurement timeline: we need internal budget sign-off by end of Q3 (we're planning a vendor short-list the week of Sep 20).

Also: two follow-up asks from Priya (copied):
- Can you show a 3-scenario estimate (pilot 150M, steady 250M, high 320M) with both hosted and dedicated options?
- Any notes on data retention and audit logs pricing — we need 1 year retention for logs for a compliance run.

Jordan
Director, ML Platforms | OrbitHealth
jordan.harris@orbithealth.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Harris <jordan.harris@orbithealth.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@orbithealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OrbitHealth — post-call recap & invoice estimate

Jordan — thanks for the quick reply and the target range. Per your ask, I pulled a short unit-economics summary from the model and attached an invoice-style estimate for the three scenarios. Highlights below: 

Unit economics (hosted API, model variant Redwood-3-small, 8-bit quantized path):
- Pilot (150M tokens/mo): ~ $54,000/mo (~$360 / 1M tokens) — includes 14-day KV cache, standard SLA, 6-month committed term.
- Steady (250M tokens/mo): ~ $87,500/mo (~$350 / 1M tokens) — recommended: enable prefix caching for embeddings to reduce tail tokens.
- High (320M tokens/mo): ~ $110,000/mo (~$344 / 1M tokens) — volume discounts applied above 300M.

Notes on components: 
- Token unit price modeled includes model inference, storage for short-term KV cache, and networking egress estimates.
- Data retention (audit logs) 1 year: add $1,200/mo for log retention and access controls (can be toggled).
- Dedicated deployment (reserved GPU pool) example: fixed monthly reserved fee + lower per-token execution; if you prefer, I can produce a dedicated vs hosted side-by-side sheet.

I attached: redwood_invoice_estimate.pdf (invoice-style summary), and updated orbithealth-pricing-model.xlsx with scenario tabs. You asked for a hosted vs dedicated comparison — I included a brief note in the XLSX but will expand if you want dedicated numbers explicitly.

Next steps suggested:
- Jordan/Priya: confirm which scenario you want as the procurement baseline (pilot vs steady).
- Marissa: if Jordan confirms baseline, can you prepare a draft order form + DocuSign for the agreed scenario and include the 1-year audit log line item?
- Sean: I'll hold any discount conversations until we have a baseline scenario; we can propose a stepped discount schedule tied to 6/12 month commits.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call Fri if you'd prefer to walk through the XLSX.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_invoice_estimate.pdf, orbithealth-pricing-model.xlsx

Jordan/Priya — looping in next steps from the order side. Per Sean’s numbers, if you confirm the pilot (150M) we will: 
- Prepare a draft order form and a DocuSign envelope (MSA + order form) with the pilot line item and 1-year audit logs as a separate line.
- Provide a hosted vs dedicated appendix in the order form so procurement can see both options.
- Target timeline: draft in 48 hours once we have confirmation of baseline scenario and final contact for signature.

Please confirm by EOD Sep 6 if you want us to proceed with the pilot order form. If you want dedicated numbers first, say so and we’ll expand the model.
